title: Voice: STT sessions capped per service, per-turn trace door, microphone choice, ending Voice by a whole phrase, Vietnamese pronouns in the reply rule
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the run.cmd below (node --test over the relay, trace door, config, reply-language and chat-input voice suites; no database, no speech key, no audio).
S2: Read the exit code and the pass/fail counts.
expect: A fifth STT session at one service with SPEECH_STT_MAX_CONCURRENT=4 ends provider-busy before any handshake, and a place is given back once by the session's own id; a fallback into a full pool ends provider-busy.
POST /api/speech/trace: 401 signed out, 400 on a non-number span, 413 past 1024 bytes, 429 past 600 an hour, one row per account and turn id, refused from another origin.
isVoiceOff/isGoodbye match only a whole finished phrase (not 'đổi chữ tạm biệt thành xin chào', not 'ciao'); with a card waiting only the turn-off phrases count.
replyLanguageRule asks for 'mình'/'bạn' whenever the reply is Vietnamese; the Voice rule has no copy of it.
evidence: Council 19/10/2026 (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh), voice backlog after #1414/#1430: cap and trace are the operational half; pronouns, mic choice and ending by voice from the 17/10 stand runs.
fence: The relay's slot pool, the trace door's limits, the phrase matchers and the reply rule, through their own tests. Not exercised: a real speech service, a real microphone, a live stand.
